evals.name: overlapping-capability
evals.prompt: Review a proposed CSV export capability against an existing filtered export scenario and a planned scheduled-export feature. Explain overlap and alternatives; do not change the documents.
evals.expected_output: Distinguishes extension, duplicate, and independent schedule behavior with citations. Presents alternatives and does not decide scope for the operator.

evals.name: missing-inventory
evals.prompt: Review this Discovery. Its manifest references its own scenario but the product brief refers to an existing capability whose document is unavailable.
evals.expected_output: Reports the missing comparison context as blocking and does not infer that no conflict exists.
